TitleClinical Trials Information System
Statusactive
Definition

CTIS is a primary registry of the World Health Organization (WHO). Data from trials published on this website is included in the search portal of WHO's International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP). This applies to relevant clinical trial data, as required by WHO, which has been published on CTIS since the launch of the system on 31 January 2022. For more information, see https://euclinicaltrials.eu/.
